- [ ] `feat` — new feature

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes

- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change, if applicable
- [ ] Added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`, if user-facing
- [ ] Added an ADR to `docs/decisions.md`, if this makes a non-obvious architectural call
